meta.title: vdown-helper — every video on the page, saved in one click
meta.description: A Chrome extension that finds the videos, streams, subtitles and files on a page and saves them on your computer. HLS and DASH joined without re-encoding, live recording, no account, no tracking.
cta.note: Chrome 116 or newer · free · nothing to sign up for
cta.storeSoon: Chrome Web Store listing coming soon. Until then: download, unzip, load. 30 seconds.
hero.body: vdown-helper finds the videos, streams, subtitles and files a page plays — even inside embedded players — puts the best one on top, and saves it on your computer. Streams are joined without re-encoding. Nothing leaves your browser.
hero.alt: The vdown-helper popup open on a demo video page, with the 1080p stream marked as best match
proof.checks: end-to-end checks in a real browser, on every change
pain.title: “Save video as…” stopped working years ago.
pain.body: Today a video arrives in hundreds of pieces, hides inside a player embedded from another site, or is assembled in memory while it plays. vdown-helper reads the page the way the player does — and hands you one clean file.
f1.title: The right file, on top.
f1.body: Direct files, HLS and DASH streams, subtitles, images and documents, from every frame of the page. Each card leads with what matters — quality, kind, size, length — and the best match comes first, with its Download one click away.
f1.alt: The popup listing a 1080p HLS stream as best match, a 1080p MP4 and a 720p clip from an embedded player
f2.title: Streams in. One clean file out.
f2.body: Pick the quality, the audio track and the format, or keep the original. Segments are joined as they are: the picture is never re-encoded. Audio conversion (MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV) runs on FFmpeg inside your browser.
f2.alt: The Studio side panel with the stream's three qualities, output mode and file name
f3.title: Real progress. Real files.
f3.body: Every stage is shown as it happens — downloading, joining, done — with speed and time left. Pause and resume, retry what failed, then open the file or its folder straight from the popup.
f3.alt: The download queue with a finished file and its Open button
f4.title: Live right now? Record it.
f4.body: Live HLS and DASH streams, camera, screen-share and call streams are recorded as they play. Stop whenever you like and what was recorded is saved; limits on length and size stop it for you.
f4.alt: A live stream card with Record, and a recording in progress with its elapsed time and size
f5.title: Private by design. Honest about DRM.
f5.body: No account, no analytics, nothing sent anywhere. Site access is asked for only when you click, and can be revoked in one place. Streams protected by DRM are marked as such and never touched.
f5.alt: A free trailer marked as best match and a DRM-protected film marked Protected, with its Download disabled
grid.title: Everything a page can play
grid.filesBody: MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV, MP3, M4A, FLAC, Opus and more — saved as they are.
grid.hlsBody: Master and media playlists, separate audio, fMP4 and TS, AES-128 encryption whose key the site delivers openly.
grid.dashBody: Static and live manifests, separate audio and video, ClearKey.
grid.mse: Players that build video in memory
grid.mseBody: When there is no file at all, it captures what the player plays — fast or in real time.
grid.liveBody: Record live HLS and DASH as they go, with gaps counted, never hidden.
grid.streamsBody: MediaStreams on the page are recorded to WebM (or MP4 where Chrome can).
grid.subsBody: VTT, SRT, TTML and subtitle tracks inside streams.
grid.zipBody: Filter by size, pick what you want, download one by one or as a ZIP.
privacy.title: It works for you. It reports to no one.
privacy.p1b: Install it and use it. There is nothing to register for.
privacy.p2b: The extension never sends the pages you visit, or anything else, to any server.
privacy.p3b: Access to a site is asked for when you press a button, one site or all of them, and revoked in one place.
privacy.p4b: Detection, joining and conversion happen inside your browser. Even this page loads nothing from anyone else.
limits.title: What it will not do
limits.drm: Bypass DRM. Widevine, PlayReady, FairPlay and SAMPLE-AES streams are marked Protected and refused — for downloads, captures and recordings.
limits.auth: Get past logins, paywalls or a site's own checks. It saves what your browser already plays.
limits.extractors: Use tricks for particular websites. It works from what the page itself shows the browser.
limits.rights: Make it legal. Save only what you have the right to save.
install.title: Up and running in 30 seconds
install.storeTitle: Add it from the Chrome Web Store
install.s1b: Get the latest package from GitHub.
install.s2b: Extract it into a folder you will keep.
install.s3b: Open chrome://extensions, switch on Developer mode, choose “Load unpacked” and pick the folder.
faq.title: Questions
faq.a1: Yes, completely, and the source code is open (MIT licence). There is no paid tier and no account.
faq.q2: Will it save any video on any site?
faq.a2: It saves what a page plays in your browser, in the formats listed above. It does not bypass DRM, logins or paywalls, and some players simply never expose a stream. When something cannot be saved, the card tells you why.
faq.q3: Why does it ask for access to a site?
faq.a3: Reading a page you are on needs nothing. Fetching a stream from another server, or looking into a player embedded from another site, needs that site's permission — asked when you press the button, revocable in Settings.
faq.a4: No. Video is never re-encoded: segments are joined as they are. Only audio is converted, and only if you ask for MP3, M4A, AAC or WAV.
faq.a5: Into Chrome's own Downloads folder, through Chrome's download manager. You can pick a sub-folder or be asked every time.
faq.a6: No. No analytics, no telemetry, no remote code. The only requests it makes are the ones that fetch the media you asked for.
final.title: Stop hunting for the file.
final.body: Open the popup. Press Download. That is it.
footer.disclaimer: Not affiliated with any website. Save only what you have the right to save.
footer.clean: This page loads no third-party scripts, fonts or trackers.
